_note: Open positions. Add one object per opening to 'openings'; leave the list empty when there are none. 'closes' (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional: past that date the opening is hidden at the next build. 'link' is optional (an ad or application page); 'contact' defaults to the lab e-mail. Example: {"title": "PhD position in genomic selection", "type": "PhD", "summary": "One or two sentences.", "start": "Fall 2027", "closes": "2027-03-01", "link": "", "contact": ""}
